Country.evidence_source: Dorothy Kizza is a PhD student at the Department of Social Work and Health Science, Norwegian University of Science and Technology, Trondheim, Norway, and a principal clinical psychologist, Butabika National Referral and Teaching Hospital Kampala, Uganda. Heidi Hjelmeland is Professor of Health Science at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology, Trondheim, Norway, and senior researcher at the Norwegian Institute of Public Health, Oslo, Norway. Dr. Eugene Kinyanda is a consultant psychiatrist who works as a research manager with the MRC/UVRI Uganda Research Unit on AIDS.
